stories.title: Fake ‘miracle business’ will collapse:Anti-superstition crusader blasts Dhirendra Shastri; dham chief hits back – ‘come to darbar’
stories.summary: The controversy surrounding Dhirendra Krishna Shastri of Bageshwar Dham's 'Divine Court' and his claims has heated up once again. The Maharashtra Andhashraddha Nirmoolan Samiti, completely rejecting the Baba's miracles, has now increased the challenge amount directly from Rs 30 lakh to Rs 80 lakh. The committee says that this fight is not against the Ramkatha, but against those claims being made in the guise of religion that do not stand up to the test of logic. Committee convener Shyam Manav had proposed the Nagpur Press Club venue for this challenge before Dhirendra Shastri, but the Baba has clearly stated that whoever wants to test him should come to the court. Now that Dhirendra Shastri has returned from Nagpur, Shyam Manav says that Shastri has failed to accept the challenge twice in a row and has fled once again. Bhaskar spoke with Anti-Superstition Eradication Committee convener Shyam Manav to understand why he is raising questions about the Baba's court. New Form of Challenge: Science's Rules Will Apply, Not Baba's The committee had made it clear that this time the contest will not be held in Baba's 'divine court', but at the 'Patrakar Bhavan' (Press Club) in Nagpur. The committee's reasoning behind this is that in Baba's own court, there could be many secret methods of gathering information, which are difficult to control. Challenge Conditions Still Remain 1. Neutral Ground: This test can only be conducted at Patrakar Bhavan in Nagpur. 2. Strict Monitoring: A panel committee will be formed, which will include Baba's consent as well. During the test, mobile phones of Baba and other people present there will be sealed. 3. 90% Accuracy Scale: 10 unknown persons will be suddenly brought before Baba. He will have to tell the names of those persons, their father's name, surname and mobile number. Additionally, he will have to identify 10 objects kept nearby using his 'divine vision'. 4. Double Test: If Baba succeeds the first time, then after 5 days the same process will be repeated again with new people. Only if 90 percent correct results are obtained both times will he be given the reward of 80 lakhs. 44 Years of Reputation versus 'Babagiri' Committee convener Shyam Manav, adopting a very aggressive stance, said, "We have been saying for the past 44 years that there is no divine power in this world. If Dhirendra Shastri proves himself, then I will bow at his feet, shut down my organization and become his devotee." The committee gave an interesting example comparing Baba's claims with modern technology. They said that in today's era, facial recognition technology at airports does similar work. Without looking at any papers, one can get information about a person's name, passport and booking details. 'Maharaj is running away from the challenge' The committee also states that Dhirendra Shastri will never accept this challenge. The committee alleges that the Baba plants his own people in his court and extracts their information in 5 minutes through photos or other means. The committee questioned that when big people like the Chief Minister of Maharashtra bow down before him, what was the Baba afraid of? It has been alleged that both Maharaj and the committee know that he does not possess any divine powers. They are merely exploiting superstition to deceive people. According to the committee, "He knew that if he participated in this impartial challenge, his 'Babagiri' business would shut down. That is why he has once again fled from this challenge." Shyam Manav had given a challenge three years ago as well In January 2023, Dhirendra Shastri had gone to Nagpur for Katha Vachana (religious discourse). At that time too, Shyam Manav had challenged him. The challenge was that Dhirendra Shastri should publicly provide accurate information about 10 people - such as name, phone number and personal details. These 10 people should be chosen by Shyam Manav, not by Baba's team. He had said that if Shastri could prove this, he would give him 30 lakh rupees. Dhirendra Shastri accepted the challenge He accepted the challenge and said that whoever has an 'itch', come to the court. Whatever knowledge and power we have, we will present it. We are not magicians. Whatever inspiration God gives us, we will guide people accordingly.

stories.title: Yogi Adityanath proposes 2-day weekly WFH after PM Modi’s appeal:Are demerits like social isolation being overlooked?
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has proposed a two-day weekly work-from-home (WFH) model for employees in large industrial units, IT companies and startups as part of a wider push to save fuel and reduce costs. The state government's move comes after Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged citizens to adopt energy-saving practices, including work from home (WFH). While the policy may offer benefits such as lower commuting expenses, are we overlooking possible demerits like loneliness, social isolation and mental strain? Let us take a closer look at what working from home actually means in practice. How many companies are offering WFH jobs in India? Remote work in India is no longer limited to a few firms. Globally, the trend is stronger. In India, major companies such as Infosys, Wipro, and HCLTech have adopted hybrid or flexible work models in recent years. In what ways does working from home benefit the nation? Working from home can support the wider economy in several practical ways. First, it helps businesses reduce operational costs. Second, WFH expands access to jobs beyond major cities. Third, digital workflows encourage investment in broadband, cloud systems and cybersecurity. Finally, flexible work models can improve employee retention. What are the salary differences between a WFH job and an on-site job? In most cases, salary depends on skill level, experience and industry, not simply on whether the job is remote or office-based. However, some differences may appear in allowances. For an individual, does WFH have more advantages or disadvantages? For knowledge-based roles, such as IT, design, writing or analysis, WFH often increases autonomy. However, the disadvantages are real. Conclusion: For most skilled, digitally based roles, advantages slightly outweigh disadvantages. Without discipline and support, disadvantages can become stronger. In which sectors can WFH never be an option? Some sectors require physical presence because the work depends on machinery, direct service or on-site supervision. In these cases, remote work is either impossible or extremely limited. How can people protect themselves from WFH scams? Graphics: Anas Shakir

stories.title: Noida Airport opens flight bookings:First flight to take off on June 15, Lucknow fare fixed at ₹5,401
stories.summary: Booking for domestic flights from Noida International Airport started on Thursday. Passengers can book their seats through portals like 'MakeMyTrip' using the airport's official code 'DXN'. Currently, 3 airlines IndiGo, Air India Express, and Akasa have signed agreements with the airport. IndiGo has released its flight schedule. The first flight will depart from Lucknow for Noida on June 15 at 7:05 AM. This flight will arrive at Noida Airport at 8:06 AM. Passengers will be able to reach Noida from Lucknow in one hour. Its fare will be Rs 5,492. The fare from Noida to Lucknow will be Rs 5,401. The first flight from Noida Airport will depart for Bengaluru at 8:35 AM. It will arrive at Bengaluru Airport at 11:05 AM. PM Modi inaugurated the Noida Airport on March 28. The first phase of the airport has been constructed in an area of 1334 hectares. A 3900-meter long runway, a terminal building, an ATC tower, and a cargo hub spread over 30 acres have been built here. Preparations have now been completed to start domestic and cargo flights from here. Indigo released the schedule See pictures of Noida Airport

stories.title: UP Police SI recruitment written exam result declared:Final answer key released; over 12,000 candidates qualify
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board has declared the written examination result for the UP Police Sub-Inspector (SI) Recruitment 2025. Along with the result, the board has also released the final answer key for the examination. According to the result released by the recruitment board, a total of 12,333 candidates have been declared successful for the next stage of the recruitment process. Selected candidates will now have to appear for document verification, Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Candidates who appeared in the written examination had been waiting for the result for a long time. The board has asked candidates to visit the official website to check their result and the final answer key. Final answer key also been released The recruitment board has also published the final answer key along with the result. The final answer key was prepared after reviewing the objections raised by candidates. The written examination result has been declared on the basis of this revised answer key. To check the result, candidates will have to click on the link available on the board’s website. After entering their registration number and date of birth, candidates will be able to view their result. A large number of candidates are visiting the website after the result announcement, due to which heavy traffic on the server is also expected. The recruitment board said that candidates who have qualified in the written examination will now have to go through the next stage of the process. Under the selection process, document verification and the Physical Standard Test (DV/PST) are proposed to be held in the third week of May. During this stage, educational certificates, identity proof and other required documents of candidates will be verified. Along with this, candidates’ height, chest measurement and other physical standards will also be checked. Next phase tests to be held now Candidates who have qualified in the written examination will now have to appear in the next stage of the recruitment process. This will include document verification, Physical Standard Test and Physical Efficiency Test. The recruitment board said that the dates and detailed schedule for the next stage will soon be released on the official website. Candidates have been advised to regularly check the website for updates.

stories.title: Brother dies on bumpy road, sister posts VIDEO appeal:Lakhimpur DM orders road repair within 24 hours
stories.summary: Three years ago, a child died in Lakhimpur Kheri after falling into water collected on a broken road. The child's mother could not bear this shock. She didn't understand how the road could be fixed so that no one else would lose their life. For this, the mother took the help of her 6-year-old daughter. The mother had her daughter make a video. In it, the daughter said - Hello DM Uncle, you are very good. Please get our road built too, we face a lot of trouble. This message was sent to the DM of Lakhimpur Kheri. Upon this, the DM reached Manvi's house via the same road she had complained about, to meet her. The DM held Manvi's hand, inspected the entire road, and immediately ordered its repair. Work on building the road has also started within 24 hours. Dainik Bhaskar's team reached her village to see the on-site conditions and meet Manvi. Read the full report Salempur village is about 3 kilometers away from Lakhimpur district. Manvi lives here. Due to its proximity to the city, development work has taken place in the village. 3 roads in this village, with a population of about 10 thousand, are interlocked. Most of the people here are employed. Some families work as laborers and raise animals. Villagers said - This work will not last long Our team first reached the road about which Manvi had complained to the DM. Here, work on the road has started within 24 hours of DM Anjani Kumar Singh's order. Soil is being filled in the potholes. The road is being raised by laying bricks. Bricks are also kept near the road. 2-3 laborers are working. The entire 1-kilometer road is being leveled. This road leads to a Dalit settlement, which has about 150 houses of poor people. Ambedkar Park, Ayushman Center, and community toilets have been built in the settlement. However, villagers say that the work being done on the road will not last long. When it rains, the road will sink again. Passing through the under-construction road, we reached Manvi's house. At home, we met Manvi's mother, Kiran Singh. Manvi's father, Guru Pratap Singh, works in a bank. Besides Manvi, they also have another one-and-a-half-year-old daughter, Devika. When we reached home, the father had gone on duty. Manvi had gone to school. Manvi's mother said - We lost our son because of the road We asked Kiran why she had her daughter make the video. She told a painful story behind it. Kiran said - I got married 9 years ago. The eldest daughter is Manvi. Then I had a son, whose name was Samarth. He died 3 years ago due to this bad road. At that time, this road was completely unpaved. One day, my husband was carrying our son in his arms. The road was filled with water. There was an electric pole there. Due to the bad road, my husband fell while passing through there. Our son slipped from his lap and fell into the water. Due to the rain, electricity had flowed into the water from the electric pole. Our son came into contact with it and died. I had this video made by my daughter for this very reason, so that no other innocent person falls victim to it now. In the year 2024, the road was paved, but it got damaged again during the rainy season. This road is very bad. When it rains, this place gets waterlogged. It becomes very muddy. Children face a lot of difficulty in passing through. Even vehicles slip. The video was made viral for this reason, so that a solution to the problem can be found. Student said - We don't go to school because of the road The team also spoke to some other children in the village. 10-year-old Payal said - There is a lot of waterlogging here. I have a lot of difficulty going to school. Meanwhile, Priya said - I am unable to go to school because of this bad road. This road gets filled with water. Villagers said - Big personalities came, yet the road was not built Abhishek Kumar from the village said - Cabinet Minister Ashish Patel has also passed through this road. He had also asked for the road to be repaired, but no work was done. Many other big personalities have also passed through here, but the road was never fixed. Now, after the girl's video came to light, work is being done here. Class Teacher said - Manvi is very active After this, our team reached CB Singh Gaur School to meet Manvi. Manvi told us - I complained to DM uncle. He has asked to get the road repaired. We face a lot of problems because of the road. Meanwhile, Manvi's class teacher said that she is a very active child. She participates in every school program. Manvi is very fond of making videos. DM Sir has started work on her request. Many thanks for this. Meanwhile, DM Anjani Kumar Singh says that upon the girl's words, I went to the spot and started the work as soon as possible. There is no good system for the drainage of rainwater. Because of this, water is accumulating. Soon all arrangements will be made.

stories.title: Yogi targets fatwa politics in Saharanpur:Pitches development model; announces projects worth ₹2,131 crore and jobs
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Thursday launched a sharp attack on what he described as “fatwa politics” while unveiling development projects worth Rs 2,131 crore in Saharanpur. Addressing a public gathering, he said the district, once associated with unrest, is now emerging as a centre of growth, connectivity and security. Strong remarks on security and extremism The Chief Minister said Saharanpur was earlier known for fatwas, riots and migration, claiming diktats were issued on trivial matters. He said the government has replaced that environment with strong security measures, including the establishment of an Anti-Terrorism Squad centre. He stressed that the government would not tolerate any attempt to disturb peace. Major development push announced During the visit, Yogi Adityanath inaugurated and laid the foundation stone for 325 projects worth Rs 2,131 crore. The event, held in Jadauda Jatt, saw participation from over 4,000 people, including a large number of women. He also distributed appointment letters to around 500 youths from three departments, highlighting employment generation. Employment and governance reforms highlighted The Chief Minister said recruitment processes have become transparent and inclusive. He described Uttar Pradesh’s 25 crore population as one family, emphasising fairness in governance. Political message after Bengal results Referring to the BJP’s victory in West Bengal, Yogi said the result has challenged political analysts and exposed attempts to divide society. He linked the outcome to broader political trends across the country. Transformation of Saharanpur over the years The Chief Minister contrasted past conditions with present developments in the district. He said Saharanpur is now gaining recognition for its woodcraft industry and improved infrastructure. Connectivity projects and changing identity Yogi highlighted key infrastructure initiatives shaping the region’s future. Airport project in final stages He said Uttar Pradesh has moved beyond its earlier “BIMARU” tag and is now a growth engine for India. The Chief Minister added that residents no longer feel the need to hide their identity outside the state, reflecting growing confidence and improved governance.

stories.title: Akhilesh meets Mamata in Kolkata:SP chief claims BJP used same political formula in Uttar Pradesh
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav met Trinamool Congress leader Mamata Banerjee in Kolkata on Thursday. Mamata’s nephew Abhishek Banerjee was also present during the meeting. The leaders discussed the results of the West Bengal Assembly elections and future political strategy. The meeting is being seen as important for the INDIA alliance. Political talks have also increased about possible coordination between the SP and TMC before the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Earlier, Akhilesh was scheduled to visit Kolkata on May 5, but Mamata had asked him to postpone the trip. He had also visited Kolkata in January this year. However, he did not campaign in West Bengal during the Assembly elections. BJP conducted a trial in Bengal: Akhilesh Yadav Speaking to the media in Kolkata, Akhilesh Yadav said, 'I observed this election very closely. The kind of language used and BJP's attitude was shocking. What BJP did in Bengal, it did less of in UP. It was trialed in Bengal.' He said, 'The way BJP works, it spreads anarchy. After the elections, it was said that several companies of security forces would remain here. They would handle security. Now where are those companies?' 'BJP has no counter to PDA in UP' Akhilesh Yadav interacted with party workers at the party headquarters on May 5. He said, 'BJP is a gathering of fake leaders. They have no faith in democracy whatsoever. Their only job is to loot. BJP shamelessly looted votes in West Bengal. They did not hesitate at all to illegally use the police and administration.' He said, 'BJP has no counter to PDA in UP. PDA has the most votes. This is why BJP is flustered.' Incidents of violence increased in Bengal after election results Incidents of violence have increased in West Bengal after the election results were announced. In North 24 Parganas, BJP leader Suvendu Adhikari's PA Chandranath Rath was shot dead on Wednesday night. The incident occurred when Rath was going home in his Scorpio. Mamata said earlier she will not resign from CM post West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee said in a press conference on Tuesday, 'I will not resign from the post of Chief Minister. We have lost not due to the mandate, but due to BJP's conspiracy. Therefore, I will not go to Raj Bhavan to resign.' BJP snatched 75 seats from TMC In West Bengal, BJP registered victory on 207 seats, while TMC was limited to 80 seats. Compared to 2021, BJP's vote share increased by about 8%. Out of the 119 seats where TMC had been continuously winning for the last 15 years, BJP won 75 seats. This means TMC lost about 63% of its strong seats.

stories.title: 17-year-old boy allegedly kills girlfriend in Prayagraj:Accused says she was pressuring him for marriage
stories.summary: A 17-year-old boy in Prayagraj allegedly strangled his minor girlfriend to death using her scarf. He also stabbed her several times with a knife. He then dumped the body in a pit near the Sharda canal and covered it with bushes so that no one could spot it. The accused had allegedly taken the 17-year-old girl away from her home on April 20. He carried out the murder the same night. The girl’s mother filed a kidnapping case against him on April 21. Since then, police had been searching for both of them. Police arrested the accused on Thursday for allegedly murdering his girlfriend. During questioning, he confessed to the crime. Based on his statement, police recovered the girl’s body. The incident took place in the Bahariya police station area. Now, understand the whole matter in a sequential manner- A dead body was found in the bushes near the canal After this, the police started tracing both of them. They questioned people from CCTV footage and the surrounding area. They tracked both their mobiles. This led to Asmit. On Thursday morning, the police apprehended Asmit from his relative's house. When asked about his girlfriend, he said, "I killed Khushi and threw her near the canal." Based on the accused's information, the police launched a search operation. Khushi Pal's decomposed body was found in the bushes near the canal. Upon receiving information about her daughter's murder, mother Sunita Pal fainted.

stories.title: Bus carrying labourers falls into canal in Kanpur:Driver jumped out of vehicle before it went down; all 20 people rescued
stories.summary: A major road accident was reported on Thursday morning (7 May) in the Bidhnu police station area of Kanpur. A private bus carrying labourers collided with a dumper, after which it lost control and fell into a canal. The incident triggered panic and chaos at the spot. Police, along with local residents, immediately launched a rescue operation and safely evacuated all 20 labourers onboard. All the passengers sustained injuries in the accident and were taken to a nearby Community Health Centre (CHC) for treatment. Driver fless scene after bus collides with dumper An injured labourer said, “The bus driver failed to control the vehicle and instead of attempting to save it, allegedly jumped off the bridge and fled, after which the bus fell into the canal”. The labourers were travelling in a private bus from Kudhni to their workplace at Trident Company in Raniya when the accident took place. Around 8 am near the Bidhnu canal, the bus reportedly collided with a dumper, went out of control and plunged into the canal, which had around 10 feet of water. Following the incident, passengers managed to come out through the windows and climbed onto the roof of the bus. Local residents, along with police and fire brigade teams, used ladders to rescue all those trapped inside. 20 labourers rescued, several critically injured Soon after the bus plunged into the canal, panic spread in the area. Locals rushed to the spot and immediately began rescue efforts. Police and administrative officials also reached the location after being alerted. A joint operation by police and residents led to the safe evacuation of all 20 labourers from the bus. The injured were quickly shifted to a nearby hospital, where treatment is underway. Officials said some of the labourers are in serious condition, while others have suffered minor injuries. Bus retrieved from water using cranes Police and fire brigade teams remained deployed at the spot following the accident. The operation to pull out the bus was carried out under the supervision of Ghatampur ACP Krishnakant Yadav and Chief Fire Officer Deepak Sharma. With the help of three cranes, including a hydra unit and an NHAI crane, the bus was finally lifted out of the canal. After nearly an hour of coordinated effort, the vehicle was successfully retrieved from the water. Accident disrupts traffic up to 10 km on Kanpur-Sagar highway Kanpur DCP (South) Deependra Nath Chaudhary collected details of the incident from police teams following the accident. The mishap led to a major traffic disruption on the Kanpur-Sagar highway. Police had to implement route diversions to manage the situation. Due to the blockage, a traffic jam stretching nearly 10 km was reported, extending up to Patara towards Hamirpur and up to Ramaipur towards Kanpur. After the bus was successfully removed from the canal, police gradually restored normal traffic movement on the highway. Narrow bridge, heavy traffic make the area accident prone The Kanpur-Sagar Highway is facing traffic load nearly ten times higher than its designed capacity. A narrow bridge over the Bidhnu canal has become a major bottleneck, with congestion reported on a daily basis. Locals say the bridge is so narrow that two vehicles cannot pass at the same time. Concerns have also been raised about the weak condition of the railing, which reportedly shakes even with slight pressure. Residents allege that these conditions are contributing to frequent accidents in the area, while authorities have so far failed to take corrective action. Passengers blame driver for accident Injured labourer Ramnaresh said, “The bus driver had been replaced just two days earlier. After the collision with the dumper, the driver jumped out of the vehicle and fled, instead of trying to control it, which led to the bus falling into the canal”. Another injured passenger, Amar Singh, who was sitting near the window said, “The driver suddenly jumped out and the bus went into the canal”. He recalled that water quickly rose up to his head and visibility was lost, but he was eventually pulled out by someone, saving his life. Another passenger named Acchelal said, “The bus suddenly plunged into the canal and water started filling inside, after which he managed to escape through the window”. Meanwhile a worker named Kishore Kumar added, “Panic spread inside the bus as water entered, and passengers broke window panes to get out. If the driver had tried to control the bus instead of fleeing, the accident could have been avoided”. Names of the injured passengers Five other people escaped unhurt. Five ambulances rush the injured to the hospital Soon after the bus plunged into the canal, five ambulances were rushed to the spot. Police shifted the injured to Bidhnu CHC in these ambulances. At the health centre, doctors provided immediate first aid to the victims. One person, reported to be in critical condition, has been referred to Kanpur District Hospital for further treatment.

stories.title: Rajiv Rudy piloted IndiGo flight hits bad weather:Aircraft shakes vigorously midair before landing safely in Lucknow
stories.summary: Indigo flight 6E-6497, traveling from Delhi to Patna, experienced turbulence amidst bad weather on Thursday. A momentary panic ensued among the passengers on board. However, former Union Minister of State and pilot Rajiv Pratap Rudy, who was commanding the flight, showed presence of mind. When the flight could not land in Patna, it was diverted to Lucknow and landed safely. After the safe landing of the flight, passengers breathed a sigh of relief. Here, the flight's captain and MP Rajiv Pratap Rudy told the passengers, ‘Now you can clap. You have landed safely.’ Flight suddenly started jolting According to information, IndiGo flight 6E6497 departed from Delhi for Patna. During the flight, the weather suddenly deteriorated, and the flight started experiencing turbulence. The severe turbulence created an atmosphere of fear among the passengers. Many passengers panicked, and there was a tense situation in the cabin for some time. Captain Rajiv Pratap Rudy tried to land the flight in Patna several times, but was unable to do so. The Captain informed the passengers about the bad weather. He said that the flight was being diverted towards Banaras. However, clearance was not received from there either. Due to this, the flight was diverted to Lucknow. Passengers clapped as soon as the captain spoke After landing, Captain Rudy smiled and told the passengers that now you can clap. Following this, the passengers on board the aircraft applauded him. During this time, many passengers praised his quick thinking and calm handling of the situation.

stories.title: Noida BJP youth leader drowns in Ganga:Falls from cruise boat while taking selfie, body found after hours of search
stories.summary: A late-night outing on the ghats of Varanasi turned tragic after a 27-year-old youth leader drowned in the Ganga river while attempting to take selfies from a cruise. The victim, identified as Harshvardhan Thakur from Greater Noida, could not be rescued despite immediate efforts. His body was recovered on Thursday morning after an extensive search operation. Leader visiting Kashi with friends Harshvardhan had arrived in the city on Wednesday evening with five friends — Kushagra Singh, Durgesh Pratap Singh, Vipul Kumar, Jeet Singh and Lalit Kumar. He was serving as a Pradesh Mantri in the BJP-supported Bhartiya Shramik Kamgar Karmchari Mahasangh. The group had planned to attend the Mangala Aarti and reached the ghats around 12:30 am. Selfie attempt leads to fatal fall According to eyewitness accounts, several cruises were stationed near the ghat. Harshvardhan climbed onto one of them to click selfies and record videos, holding mobile phones in both hands. While attempting to move from one cruise to another, he lost his footing and fell into the river. He reportedly cried out for help as he was swept away by the strong current. Immediate rescue efforts fail in darkness Friends raised an alarm, prompting local divers present at the ghat to jump into the river. A search operation continued for nearly three hours through the night, but visibility issues and the strong current hampered efforts. Despite repeated attempts, Harshvardhan could not be traced. Search resumes at dawn, body recovered The rescue operation resumed early Thursday morning around 6 am, with teams including the NDRF joining the search. After nearly one and a half hours, the body was recovered from the river at around 7:30 am, bringing the overnight operation to a close. Family arrives, last rites formalities completed Family members reached Varanasi after being informed and were inconsolable on seeing the body. Police sent the remains for post-mortem and later handed them over to the family. The incident highlights the dangers of unsafe movement around anchored vessels and strong river currents, particularly during late hours.

stories.title: BJP targets 17 lakh voters through Shiksha Mitras in UP:Equations may shift in 43 Assembly seats ahead of 2027 polls
stories.summary: After a sweeping victory in West Bengal and Assam, the BJP is now fully focused on Uttar Pradesh. Ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections, the battle between the BJP and the Samajwadi Party to shape and control the political narrative has intensified. The Yogi government’s decision to organise a ‘Shiksha Mitra Samman Samaroh’ to announce higher honorariums for Shiksha Mitras and instructors is being seen as part of this strategy. Political experts believe that one Shiksha Mitra can influence around 10 voters in Uttar Pradesh. Through nearly 1.68 lakh Shiksha Mitras and instructors, the BJP is trying to reach and influence close to 17 lakh voters. At the same time, the BJP is also trying to counter criticism over the merger of government schools. Meanwhile, sensing the political risk, the Samajwadi Party has started building a counter narrative against the move. Influence seen as key factor in 43 assembly seats Shiksha Mitras are believed to have a significant impact on more than 43 assembly seats in Uttar Pradesh, supported by their families and wider social networks. The state has around 1.68 lakh Shiksha Mitras and instructors. According to political analysts, each Shiksha Mitra is estimated to influence around 10 voters, including family members, relatives and neighbours. On this basis, their combined influence is believed to extend to nearly 16.80 lakh voters. This translates to an average influence of around 4,000 voters per assembly seat. In the 2022 Assembly elections, nearly 43 constituencies saw victory margins of less than 4,000 votes, with the BJP winning 25 of these seats and the SP securing 18. Against this backdrop, the BJP’s move to enhance honorarium, insurance coverage and cashless treatment benefits for Shiksha Mitras and instructors is being seen as an attempt to strengthen its position in closely contested constituencies ahead of the next elections. Now understand the politics related to Shiksha Mitras Shiksha Mitras’ political tilt shaped by past recruitment and court rulings Shiksha Mitras and instructors are widely viewed in political circles as having a traditional inclination towards the Samajwadi Party (SP). During its tenure, the Akhilesh government had decided to absorb Shiksha Mitras into government schools as assistant teachers. As part of this process, around 58,000 Shiksha Mitras were appointed in June 2014, followed by about 91,000 in April 2015. This transition significantly increased their salaries to approximately ₹35,000–₹40,000. However, the decision was later struck down first by the High Court and subsequently upheld by the Supreme Court. Apart from increase in honorarium no major changes were introduced by BJP When the BJP came to power, there were expectations of relief for Shiksha Mitras. However, apart from an increase in honorarium from ₹3,500 to ₹10,000, no major changes were introduced. This led to a perception among many Shiksha Mitras that their broader demands were not being addressed by the BJP government. As a result, in the 2019 Lok Sabha and 2022 Assembly elections, a large section is believed to have openly supported the SP, hoping for reinstatement as assistant teachers if the SP returned to power. In 2022, BJP did not allow Shiksha Mitras to become polling agents Observing the perceived political leaning of Shiksha Mitras towards the SP, the BJP is said to have restricted their role as polling agents during the 2022 Assembly elections. After the BJP’s return to power, the situation gradually began to change. Engagements between Shiksha Mitra organisations and the government were interpreted as a signal that their concerns were being taken more seriously. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath also interacted with them during the ‘School Chalo Abhiyan’, which helped raise expectations regarding long-pending demands such as regularisation and a 12-month honorarium. Following these developments, the earlier confrontational stance of many Shiksha Mitras appeared to soften. The government later announced an increase in their honorarium, which was also included in the budget and implemented from April this year. SP targets BJP government over school merger issue Despite the recent increase in honorarium, the Samajwadi Party has continued its criticism, highlighting that during its tenure Shiksha Mitras were made assistant teachers with salaries of around ₹35,000–₹40,000, and asserting that such benefits would be restored if it returns to power. The party is also attempting to build public sentiment against the government over the merger of government schools, using initiatives such as ‘PDA Pathshala’. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav has also been active on social media platform X, posting messages and letters addressed to Shiksha Mitras, recalling their appointment as teachers during the SP regime. Overall, the opposition appears to be focusing on sustaining dissatisfaction among Shiksha Mitras against the current government. As part of this effort, the Teachers’ Assembly has also been mobilised, with the party projecting itself as the only political force capable of resolving their long-standing issues. CM Yogi highlights welfare measures for Shiksha Mitras Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has cautioned Shiksha Mitras and instructors to remain alert against what he termed as attempts to mislead them for political gains. He made these remarks on May 5 at the Shiksha Mitra Samman Samaroh in Gorakhpur, stating that earlier governments had appointed teachers without proper provisions, a decision later invalidated by the Supreme Court. The Chief Minister said, “The current government continued to support Shiksha Mitras. In 2017, the honorarium was increased to ₹10,000, and later further enhanced to ₹18,000”. He also alleged, “Some individuals had tried to exploit Shiksha Mitras for political purposes and draw them into opposition-driven narratives. The government had stood with them once their concerns were understood”. 2027 election targeted with triple cover announcement Higher honorarium pushes annual burden to over ₹1,475 crore The honorarium of around 1.29 lakh Shiksha Mitras in Uttar Pradesh is disbursed under the Centre’s Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan on a 60:40 funding pattern between the Centre and the state. In addition, there are 13,597 Shiksha Mitras whose entire payment is borne by the Uttar Pradesh government. With the recent increase in honorarium, the state government’s financial liability has risen significantly, amounting to ₹1,257.77 crore. Similarly, the revision in honorarium for 24,717 instructors working in upper primary schools has added an additional burden of ₹217.50 crore. Overall, the combined annual financial impact on the state exchequer has now reached approximately ₹1,475.27 crore.

stories.title: Two Rajasthan dacoits killed in Mathura encounter:Held businessman's family hostage and looted their house
stories.summary: Police shot dead two dacoits during an encounter in Mathura after they allegedly held a businessman and his family hostage during a robbery. Both criminals carried a reward of ₹50,000 each on their heads and were linked to the Babariya gang. The deceased have been identified as Dharmveer alias Lambu and Rajendra alias Pappu, both originally from Rajasthan. They, along with three accomplices, had allegedly looted the house of businessman Ajay Agarwal on the night of April 23. According to reports, the accused entered the house through the roof and tied up Ajay Agarwal, his father, wife, and 6-year-old daughter. At gunpoint, they took the locker keys and looted valuables for nearly two and a half hours. Following the incident, SSP Shlok Kumar formed 17 police teams to trace the accused. Acting on a tip-off, police tracked their movement near the Yamuna Expressway on Wednesday morning. Around 7 am, police spotted two suspects on a bike. When signalled to stop, they attempted to flee, lost control of the vehicle, and fell. The accused then opened fire at the police, who retaliated in self-defence. Both were injured in the exchange and later declared dead at the hospital. Two police personnel, SWAT team in-charge Ajay Verma and Head Constable Durg Vijay, were also injured in the encounter. Police said Dharmveer had 16 criminal cases registered against him across Mathura, Haryana, Delhi, and Rajasthan, including charges of dacoity, attempt to murder, snatching, and theft. Rajendra alias Pappu had 11 cases registered against him in multiple states on similar charges. Pictures of the encounter- The businessman's house was robbed on April 23 They used to commit crimes by changing names SSP Shlok Kumar said- Police were searching for criminals after registering an FIR in a dacoity case in Sureer police station area. After this, the criminals also committed incidents in Noida, Khair, Delhi, Palwal and Rewari. Meanwhile, police got information about their movement last night. 11 cases were registered against dacoit Rajendra and 16 cases including theft, robbery, and dacoity were registered against Dharmvir. They used to commit crimes by changing their names. They had been to jail several times. Some amount of money and jewelry from the items taken in the dacoity have been recovered from them.

stories.title: Young TV actress leaves glamour world, chooses path of renunciation:Anna says, 'Premanandji came in dream asked to chant Radhe-Radhe'
stories.summary: Leaving behind the glitz and glamour of Mumbai, the world of lights, camera and action, actress Anaa Jaisinghani, a resident of Gwalior, is now chanting the name of Radha in Vrindavan. She has left her acting career and chosen the path of spirituality. Aana says, ‘This is not my decision, it is the grace of Radharani and Thakur Ji. They pulled me from Mumbai and called me to Vrindavan.’ She said, 'Earlier, I never used to do worship and devotion to God. I used to work with big people in the TV industry. I have also worked in many TV serials. The audience also liked me a lot. But, I don't know why I didn't find peace there. I used to remain troubled. I would spend many nights crying. Then Shri Ji showed me the way.'' Anna is a resident of Gwalior Actress Anna Jaysinghani's family lives in Gwalior. She came to Vrindavan in search of spirituality and peace and has now adapted to the ways here. She has been living alone in a flat near Kelikunj Ashram in Vrindavan for the past 2 years. She has completely given up her acting career. After coming to Vrindavan, not just Anna's mind, but even her attire has changed. Now she wears simple clothes. She wears a tulsi garland around her neck and earrings made of tulsi wood with the name Radha written on them. She applies the tilak of the Radhavallabh sect and sandalwood on her forehead. She keeps chanting the name of Radha with a rosary in her hand. Reached ISKCON during acting course Anna Jaysinghani, who went to Mumbai to learn acting, had her life completely transformed after connecting with ISKCON. Anna says - During my acting course at Ekta Kapoor's Balaji Telefilms, some of my friends used to go to ISKCON. I also came to the temple for the first time with them. That's where spirituality began in my life. Life changed through 'Naam Jap' Anna says, “In the beginning, I only used to go to the temple. I didn't do regular chanting or use prayer beads. I used to eat onions and garlic. But, I attended Bhagavad Gita classes by acharyas at ISKCON. Then I understood that chanting the name can bring salvation to life. After that, I started chanting with beads and adopted a sattvic lifestyle. Gradually, I even stopped eating onions and garlic.” On giving up non-veg, she says Killing living beings is a sin She said, “That's when I understood that eating non-veg is wrong. Filling one's stomach by killing a living being is a sin. Just as one fears for their own child, every living being's family must also feel pain. This is the biggest crime. These are the doors to hell. This is where the change came within me. With this thought, I gave up non-veg.” Got work in TV, but found peace here Anna said, “I worked in 'Savdhaan India', 'Fear Files' and Sony channel's show 'Dekha Ek Khwaab'. Aruna Irani ma'am was also in it. In 'Dekha Ek Khwaab' my character was named 'Chikki'. Which gave me a lot of recognition. People started recognizing me. The audience liked me a lot, During this time too, I used to go to ISKCON. But as they say, we want something and something else happens. Everything happens by God's will. We wanted that today we are on the small screen, tomorrow we'll come on the big screen. But, Thakurji held my hand and pulled me. Gradually he made me realize, all these are material things," she added. Mumbai's 'Reel Life', Vrindavan's 'Real Life' Explaining the difference between life in Mumbai and Vrindavan, Anna says - Vrindavan cannot be compared with anything. Life in Vrindavan is simple. Life in Mumbai is about show-off. There is reel life there and real life here. There we used to think about what people would say. Whereas in Vrindavan it feels like only Krishna is watching us. There your fake identity will be visible. But in Vrindavan, that form of yours will emerge which God has really made you. Once Sant Premanand Maharaj came in my dream Anna Jaysinghani says - I remained associated with ISKCON for about 2 years. After that, I started going to Keli Kunj. When people asked what happened, I would only say that this is Shri Ji's wish. One day Premanand Maharaj came in my dream. His coming in the dream was no small matter. When the dream came, I was very troubled at that time. Many times I would start crying. I used to feel very anxious and restless. Many times I even felt like leaving Vrindavan. Without the guru's initiation, one cannot attain God. That's why I was in search of a guru. Then one day I spoke my heart's matter to Shri Ji, asking who is my guru? Then Shri Ji heard my heart's matter and that very night I had Maharaj Ji's dream and then everything changed. In the dream itself, Maharaj Ji explained to me. In the dream itself, he gave me the guru mantra for naam japa. Since then I found the goal of life. My family is with me, I wasted a lot of time Anna Jaysingani says - Ever since I walked on the path of spirituality, my family has supported me. When I came to Vrindavan, before that no one in our house was in the line of devotion. Today my mother chants the name. She has given up making and eating onion-garlic at home. Today the path has changed. Whenever I see photos-videos of the limelight, I laugh thinking where was I? If I had received Maharaj ji's refuge at that time, my time would not have been wasted. But, at that time there was no knowledge. When I gained knowledge by listening to Maharaj ji's discourses, then I understood what I was doing. Anna, while sharing her life experiences with the youth, says to chant the name. Whenever you get time, chant the name of whichever God you believe in.

stories.title: MP tourism has no weather alert system for cruise boats:Bhaskar reveals major lapses, false claims in Jabalpur boat tragedy
stories.summary: A probe into the Bargi Dam cruise accident in Jabalpur has exposed major lapses by the Tourism Department. A Dainik Bhaskar investigation found that the cruise was operating without insurance, as the policy had been issued only in the name of Mekal Resort. The department also allegedly failed to inform the insurer that the resort operated a passenger cruise service. The investigation further revealed there was no mechanism to communicate weather alerts to the pilot and crew. Weather monitoring was left entirely to the pilot. Despite a weather alert issued on April 30, the cruise continued operations, even as similar services in Varanasi were suspended over the warning. Passengers were not given any emergency or safety briefing. The state government has ordered an inquiry into the lapses. Taking suo motu cognisance, the High Court directed authorities to register an FIR and submit a report within two days. Ahead of the official findings, Bhaskar’s report details the alleged negligence at multiple levels. The responsibility of monitoring weather lies entirely with the pilot. Despite the alert on April 30, the cruise was operated, whereas operations were stopped in Varanasi for the same reason. Passengers were not given emergency or safety instructions. The government has ordered an inquiry into these negligence. The High Court has taken suo motu cognizance and directed registration of an FIR and submission of a report within two days. Before the investigation report, Bhaskar is revealing at what level the negligence occurred. Read the report..... Know about these lies in detail 1. The Biggest Lie: Insurance in the name of resort, no mention of cruise Tourism Department's Water Activity Head Retired Naval Commander Rajendra Nigam claimed that the cruise insurance was expiring on March 21 and the premium was sent on March 19, which was not approved by the company. What is the truth?: Officials of United India Insurance Company stated that the department had not taken insurance in the name of the cruise at all. The policy was in the name of 'Maikal Resort'. The department also did not inform the company that the resort operates a cruise and that passengers board it. The resort's insurance expired on March 21. On March 24, the department sent a premium of Rs 37,003. Upon learning about the cruise operation, the company returned the money on April 2. According to the company, 'Marine Category' insurance is mandatory for cruises, which requires registration and valuation, but the department did not provide this. The cruise was illegally operated by taking insurance for the resort under the 'Public Liability Insurance Act 1991'. 2. Warning ignored: 41 lives at stake for Rs 8,000 On the day of the accident, the Meteorological Department had issued a 'Yellow Alert' 24 hours in advance and a 'Now Cast' warning 3 hours before about a storm with rain at 60 km per hour. MP Tourism has no system to relay this alert to the pilot. For a ticket collection of Rs 8800 at Rs 220 per person, the lives of 41 passengers were put at risk. Captain Mahesh Patel admitted that he does not receive weather information and operates the cruise based on guesswork. Varanasi showed wisdom On April 29, 721 people had made bookings for cruises in Varanasi. After the weather department's warning, all tickets were cancelled and money was refunded. Here, 7 cruises operate for Ganga Darshan, which have a capacity of 70 to 110 people. Ajay, operator of Vishwanath Cruise, said that bookings were cancelled on the 29th due to the forecast of strong winds. Cruises and boats are prohibited when winds exceed 25 km per hour. 3. Safety and rescue 'system fail' According to rules, wearing life jackets is mandatory for every passenger, but in Bargi they were taken into the middle of the water without jackets. When the cruise started sinking, attempts were made to get the jackets out, but it was too late. Captain Mahesh Patel said that when water started filling in and one engine stopped, he called for help, but the rescue boat did not arrive on time. At that time, the manager of Mackal Resort was in Jabalpur. That means there was no backup plan. 4. Attempt to destroy evidence? cruise dismantled before investigation Serious questions are being raised about the dismantling of the cruise after the accident. There are allegations that it was hastily destroyed to hide poor structure and technical flaws. However, the department argues that it was necessary to rescue people trapped in the cabin. Straight Talk: Rajendra Nigam, Water Activity Head, MP Tourism Question: What do you consider to be the cause of the accident? Answer: This is completely a natural disaster. In 17 years, none of our boats have had an accident. If there had been negligence, there would have been an accident earlier as well. Question: Why did water fill in the cruise? Answer: There was a cyclone that day and the wind speed was so high that the rear part of the cruise stopped working and it capsized. Technically the cruise was fit, it had been repaired in July 2024 itself. Question: Why wasn't the weather department's warning seen? Answer: The staff has been given training. The skipper is qualified. A system for local warnings is now being developed. I could not see that day's warning. Question: Why was the cruise broken? Answer: Our priority was to save people. The cruise had capsized and it was not possible to reach some parts, so it had to be broken.

stories.title: Storms and rain in 8 districts, including Lucknow:Alert Issued for 44 districts, western UP under cloudy skies; people get relief from heat
stories.summary: The spell of storms and rain continues in UP on Thursday morning, when it rained in Lucknow and Pratapgarh. Strong winds had been blowing since late night. Clouds were overcast. At dawn, a storm began and then the rain started. Even now, clouds are covering the sky and there is intermittent drizzling. The cold is being felt due to the light wind. The speed of vehicles on the roads has slowed down. Storms and heavy rain in Lucknow and surrounding areas Meanwhile, the Meteorological Department has issued an alert for storms and heavy rain in Lucknow and surrounding areas for the next 3 hours. In the alert sent on mobile phones, it has been said that winds can blow at a speed of 50 to 70 km per hour along with lightning. During this time, there will be heavy rain. Everyone should remain alert. Go out of the house only if necessary. Relief from scorching heat Actually, the weather has been bad in the state for the past 7 days. Due to storms and rain, the maximum temperature has come down below 40C. The Meteorological Department says that the weather has changed due to western disturbance and snowfall in the mountains. Today, that is Thursday, there is an alert for storms and rain in 44 districts. Talking about the last 24 hours, Banda remained the hottest in the state with a maximum temperature of 38 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, Bijnor had the coldest night with 16 degrees. Lucknow's meteorological scientist Atul Singh said- Clouds are forming due to the active Western Disturbance over North India. Moisture-laden winds coming from the Bay of Bengal and dry winds coming from the west are colliding with each other, making the atmosphere unstable. The weather will deteriorate today. From tomorrow there will be some improvement in it. Heat will show its intensity again. Weather Pictures- What will the weather be like for the next 5 days?

stories.title: Hamirpur boat tragedy:Rescue ops continue in Yamuna on Day 2; 'please bring back my child,' mother pleads, 5 bodies recovered
stories.summary: A boat overturned in the Yamuna River in Hamirpur district on Wednesday evening, carrying nine people, including eight children. The boatman managed to save three people, but six others, one woman and five children, drowned. By Thursday afternoon, five bodies had been recovered, while one child remains missing, and search operations are still underway. A massive rescue operation involving NDRF and Flood PAC teams with around 100 personnel is continuing. Officials said the river’s depth is making diving difficult, so boats are being moved in circular motion in hopes that water pressure may bring bodies to the surface. A net-based search operation is also being planned. Relatives of the victims are sitting at the riverbank, with one grieving mother pleading with officials to bring back her child. The accident occurred around 6 PM on Wednesday, and rescue operations had to be halted at night due to rain and strong winds. Operations resumed at 6 AM on Thursday with multiple boats deployed. Victims identified, one child still missing The recovered bodies have been identified as Brijrani (25), and children Archana (14), Rani (9), Lavyansh (5), and Aakanksha (9). Eleven-year-old Aditya is still missing. See photos 5 km search operation underway NDRF and SDRF teams are conducting a 5-km search operation using boats. Divers are not entering the water due to the extreme depth. Boats are being rotated in circles to create pressure waves in hopes of surfacing submerged bodies. Authorities are also preparing to deploy nets in the river to prevent bodies from drifting further downstream and to aid recovery efforts. How the accident happened The incident took place in Kutubpur Patiya under Kurara police station in Bhaulee village panchayat, located along the Yamuna River. A wedding had taken place on Tuesday in the village. On Wednesday evening, after the bride’s farewell, nine people including boatman Dheeru crossed the river by boat to visit relatives on the other side. After eating watermelon and cucumber, they were returning when the boat lost balance in the river and capsized. The boat was being operated by Dheeru, who managed to rescue three people, but six others drowned.

stories.title: Vinesh says ‘Jhukane ki taqat nahi kisi talwar mein’:Brij Bhushan calls it a ‘drama’, wrestler denied entry to Gonda wrestling event
stories.summary: The ongoing verbal clash between wrestler Vinesh Phogat and former Wrestling Federation of India president Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh has intensified, with both sides targeting each other indirectly on social media without taking names. The controversy resurfaced after the Senior National Ranking Wrestling Competition began on Sunday at Nandini Nagar Mahavidyalaya in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh, an institution linked to Brij Bhushan Singh. Vinesh was not allowed to participate in the event. Vinesh shares emotional post on X After being excluded from the tournament, Vinesh Phogat posted an emotional message on X. Soon afterwards, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh responded with a cryptic post of his own. Vinesh Phogat was planning to make her return to competitive wrestling through the National Open Ranking event. However, the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI) issued her a show-cause notice and barred her from domestic competitions until June 26. The federation accused her of indiscipline and violating anti-doping regulations. According to WFI, she failed to complete the mandatory six-month notice period required under United World Wrestling rules for athletes returning from retirement. Vinesh had announced her retirement after being disqualified from the final of the 2024 Paris Olympics for being overweight. Sexual harassment allegations against Brij Bhushan Around three years ago, Vinesh Phogat accused Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh of sexually harassing female wrestlers. Several women wrestlers, including Sakshi Malik and Bajrang Punia, joined protests against him at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar in 2023. Vinesh is currently a Congress MLA from Julana in Haryana, while Brij Bhushan is a former BJP MP. One of his sons is currently an MP in Uttar Pradesh and another is an MLA. See pictures- Wrestling competition inaugurated by Brij Bhushan The 2026 Open Senior National Ranking Wrestling Competition is being held at the sports stadium of Nandini Nagar Mahavidyalaya in Gonda. On Sunday at 10 am, Wrestling Federation president Sanjay Singh and former MP Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh inaugurated the tournament. They also met wrestlers and interacted with participants. However, shortly after the inauguration, Brij Bhushan left for another programme. In earlier years, he was often seen staying at such events to encourage wrestlers. Vinesh returned from Lucknow without participating Vinesh Phogat had travelled to Lucknow on Saturday night with plans to participate in the tournament in Gonda. However, she later returned without attending the event. WFI president Sanjay Singh said Vinesh Phogat had been served a notice over allegations of indiscipline. He warned that if her response was found unsatisfactory, stricter action, including a ban, could be imposed. He said, 'Vinesh has now become used to making allegations about everything. When she expressed her wish to participate, we took complete responsibility for her safety. It was our duty to bring her safely, arrange her matches and ensure her return.' He added that female wrestlers from across the country, including many from Haryana, were participating in the event and said questioning the federation’s system was unfair. Federation issued 15-page notice The Wrestling Federation alleged in a 15-page notice that Vinesh’s conduct during the Paris Olympics controversy had damaged the reputation of Indian wrestling permanently. The notice also claimed she violated the federation’s constitution, international wrestling rules and anti-doping guidelines. Vinesh had earlier questioned the security arrangements for her participation in Gonda. Following this, the WFI suspended her from domestic competitions until June 26. Wrestlers from 29 states are taking part More than 1,400 wrestlers from 29 states are participating in the three-day competition in Gonda. Freestyle wrestling bouts were held on the opening day on Sunday. The first match on Mat B in the 97 kg category was between Haryana’s Ashish and Sheetal Guliya. The second match in the same category featured UP’s Rajat against Haryana’s Alok Malik. The third bout was contested between Haryana’s Maan Kumar and UP’s Deepesh Kumar. Wrestling returns to Gonda after 3 years This is the first major wrestling competition being held in Gonda in three years. The last National Wrestling Competition organised here in 2023 was later cancelled by the Sports Ministry following allegations raised by protesting wrestlers against the Wrestling Federation of India. After the controversy in 2023, national-level wrestling events have now resumed in Gonda in 2026. How the sexual harassment controversy began ? On January 18, 2023, wrestlers Vinesh Phogat, Sakshi Malik and Bajrang Punia launched a protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi and accused Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh of sexually harassing female wrestlers. During the protest, Vinesh broke down in tears and alleged that Brij Bhushan and some coaches sexually harassed women wrestlers at national camps. She claimed Brij Bhushan stayed in the players’ hotel despite rules prohibiting it. She also alleged that after her defeat at the Tokyo Olympics, he had called her a “bad coin”. Brij Bhushan denied allegations Responding to the allegations at the time, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh denied all accusations and said no harassment had taken place. He stated that if the allegations were proven true, he would “hang himself”. He also described the wrestlers’ protest as politically sponsored and accused Congress Rajya Sabha MP Deepender Hooda of being behind it. Brij Bhushan further claimed that the protesting wrestlers were no longer fit to compete even at national-level tournaments.

stories.title: Tigress sits with 2 cubs before tourists:Bear and tiger came face to face in Dudhwa Tiger Reserve
stories.summary: A tigress was spotted resting with her two cubs in the middle of a road inside Dudhwa Tiger Reserve in Lakhimpur. The rare sight left tourists stunned when their safari jeep reached the spot on Saturday morning. The tourists immediately stopped their vehicle and quietly captured the thrilling moment on camera. After resting for some time, the tigress got up with her cubs and slowly moved back into the forest. Tourists witness tiger and bear face-off As the safari jeep moved further ahead, tourists witnessed another dramatic scene, a tiger and a bear standing face to face in the forest. Seeing the tense situation, the safari guide immediately instructed everyone to remain inside the vehicle. For nearly 10 minutes, both animals stared at each other without moving. Eventually, the tiger changed its path and disappeared into the jungle, avoiding a confrontation. The incident took place in the Sonaripur range of the reserve and was recorded on camera by guide Raju. The video has since gone viral on social media. See the pictures- Wildlife photographers from Gujarat were on Safari According to officials, a team of wildlife photographers from Gujarat was on a safari in the Sonaripur range on Saturday. Tiger Reserve guide Raju accompanied the group during the visit. During the safari, they first encountered the tigress sitting on the road with her cubs. Later, while returning from the forest, they came across the tiger and bear face-off. Bears avoid areas with High Tiger Movement Wildlife experts say that in core forest areas where tiger density and patrolling are very high, bears generally avoid those routes and move towards safer and denser parts of the forest to reduce the risk of conflict with large carnivores. This made the rare encounter between the tiger and the bear even more unusual for the tourists present at the spot. Tiger population estimated between 135 and 153 According to tiger census data from 2022 to 2024, Dudhwa Tiger Reserve is estimated to have a tiger population of between 135 and 153. The reserve is home to several famous tigers, including the “Beldanda” tigress, known for giving birth to 13 cubs, and “Gabbar”, often referred to as the “Don of Dudhwa”. Kishanpur Range has highest Tiger density The Kishanpur range of the reserve has the highest tiger density because of the abundance of prey animals. Officials estimate that nearly five tigers are found per 100 square kilometres in this area. In the main Dudhwa forest area, the dense Sal forests support an average of two tigers per 100 square kilometres. Distinct identity of the Terai Forest Dudhwa forest spreads across nearly 490 square kilometres and is known for its rich Terai ecosystem. The forest contains dense Sal and Teak trees along with vast grasslands locally known as “Phanta”. These grasslands serve as an ideal habitat for animals such as deer and swamp deer, also known as barasingha. Rivers, including the Suheli and Mohana flow through the reserve, helping maintain marshlands, ponds, and lakes that remain filled with water throughout the year. Tigers, Rhinos and Barasingha are major attractions Dudhwa Tiger Reserve is considered one of the richest biodiversity zones in the region. More than 135 Bengal tigers roam freely across the forest. The reserve is also home to one-horned rhinoceroses brought from Assam’s Kaziranga National Park, which have now successfully established a population of more than 50 animals. Dudhwa also holds special importance for the conservation of barasingha. A significant portion of the world’s swamp deer population survives in the reserve’s marshy grasslands.

stories.title: 6 new ministers inducted into Yogi cabinet, 2 promoted:Bhupendra Chaudhary and Manoj Pandey take oath as cabinet ministers
stories.summary: The Yogi cabinet underwent its second expansion on Sunday. Two cabinet ministers and four Ministers of State were inducted, while two existing Ministers of State were promoted to Ministers of State (Independent Charge). The oath-taking ceremony was held at Raj Bhavan. Former BJP state president Bhupendra Chaudhary was the first to take oath. He was followed by MLA Manoj Pandey, who had rebelled against the Samajwadi Party. Both have been inducted as cabinet ministers. Ajit Pal took oath third, followed by Somendra Tomar. Both were previously Ministers of State and have now been elevated to Ministers of State (Independent Charge). 4 leaders inducted as Ministers of State Krishna Paswan, Kailash Rajput, Surendra Diler and Hansraj Vishwakarma then took oath as Ministers of State. Krishna Paswan arrived wearing a ‘Radhe-Radhe’ stole, while Surendra Diler was dressed in saffron attire. After taking oath, Krishna Paswan raised slogans of “Jai Shri Ram”. Social representation in cabinet expansion Among the newly inducted ministers, one belongs to the Brahmin community, three are from OBC groups and two are from Dalit communities. There is speculation that Bhupendra Chaudhary may be assigned the Public Works Department (PWD). The ministry has remained with Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath since Jitin Prasada moved to the Centre as a minister. Yogi government now at full ministerial strength With the latest expansion, the Yogi government has reached its full strength of 60 ministers. The cabinet now includes 23 cabinet ministers, 16 Ministers of State (Independent Charge) and 21 Ministers of State. The first expansion of the Yogi cabinet took place on 5 March 2024, just ahead of the Lok Sabha elections. stories.title: 7.28 lakh meters to be converted to postpaid:Process started in 7 districts of Gorakhpur-Basti division
stories.summary: After public opposition, the government has decided to convert prepaid smart meters to postpaid. The number of such meters in the 7 districts of Gorakhpur and Basti divisions is 7 lakh 28 thousand 763. The process of converting them to postpaid has started. For now, the hassle of recharging has been eliminated, and no one's electricity will be cut off. After the meters become postpaid, connections of those who do not pay their electricity bills on time will be disconnected. After depositing the money, it will be reconnected in auto mode. The work of installing new meters in place of old meters in premises will continue, but these will not be converted to prepaid mode. The work of operating in prepaid mode had started in September 2025 The operation of postpaid smart meters in prepaid mode was initiated in September 2025. Messages were sent to consumers for this purpose. They were informed that the outstanding dues from before the operation in prepaid mode would be deposited in installments along with the prepaid meter recharge. This means that when a consumer recharged through the prepaid meter for electricity consumption, the outstanding dues of the old meter would also be deposited from that amount. Know how the problem increased While an awareness campaign was being run regarding electricity consumption through prepaid meters, even after depositing money, no accurate information was being recorded in the UPPCL Smart app regarding outstanding dues and old arrears in the meter, which was increasing the problem. Consumers alleged that even after recharging the meter, arrears were continuously showing in the app. Also, electricity was getting cut off at any time. Those who don't have Android phones were not able to find out anything at all. In recent days, women in the Gangtahi sub-center area of Sahjanwa block had uprooted prepaid meters from premises and staged a protest. Protests were taking place at several locations in the state. Consumer Adarsh from the Taramandal area said that despite continuous bill payments and running only one AC, the app sometimes shows a maximum demand of six kilowatts and sometimes shows something else. Even after recharging the meter several times in a single day, the outstanding amount does not get cleared. Ban on installing prepaid meters was imposed on April 18, but they are being installed on new connections A ban was imposed on installing smart prepaid meters on April 18 until technical flaws were investigated. Before this ban, they had already been installed at 7 lakh 22 thousand premises in the Gorakhpur-Basti division. Smart prepaid meters are to be installed at 26 lakh 95 thousand 826 premises in both divisions. Now, old meters are not being removed and replaced with smart prepaid meters, but the process of installing them on new connections will continue. It is being assumed that after converting all prepaid meters to postpaid, only postpaid meters will be installed for new connections as well. After converting prepaid meters to postpaid, messages for negative bills will not come. A ban has also been imposed on disconnecting connections. Now, consumers will get a lot of relief. This is the situation in the districts of Gorakhpur and Basti divisions

stories.title: Labour organisations stage protest demonstration in Lucknow:Supported workers' movement in Noida; demonstrators allege leaders behind agitation were made to disappear
stories.summary: Protest demonstration at Charbagh Railway Station in Lucknow. Under the banner of the All India Central Council of Trade Union, various labor organizations called for a march from Charbagh to the CM's residence. People from various social and labor organizations have taken to the streets against the workers' protest that took place in Noida in recent days, and the police action against it. The protesters were moving towards the Chief Minister's residence from Charbagh, carrying red flags and posters in their hands. The protesters were stopped by installing triple-layer barricading at Charbagh. The protesters said that the lathi charge was brutally carried out on workers in Noida. Workers in Noida had taken to the streets for their rights - getting respectable wages and facilities is the right of every worker. But instead of giving these workers their rights, police action was taken against them.

stories.title: Weather to worsen again in UP after 2 days:Storm and rain alert from May 12; Jhansi hottest, temperature rises 5°C within 2 days
stories.summary: The spell of storms and rain in UP has paused for two days. Since Sunday morning, the weather across the entire state has been clear. Bright sunshine has emerged. However, light cool winds are reducing the effect of the sun. There is no alert for storms or rain anywhere on Sunday. After about 7 days, the day temperature reached 40 °C on Saturday. On Sunday too, the mercury is expected to remain between 40 °C and 43 °C. The Meteorological Department says that the effect of the current western disturbance has completely ended. However, from May 12, the weather will deteriorate again. A new western disturbance is becoming active. This will start another spell of rain. Conditions like storms and hail will develop. Speaking of the last 24 hours, there was no rain anywhere in the state. Jhansi remained the hottest. The maximum temperature here was recorded at 40 °C. Two days ago, that is on May 8, the mercury was recorded at 34.8 °C. This means there has been a jump of 5°C. Sultanpur's night was the coldest. The minimum temperature here was recorded at 19 °C. Senior scientist Atul Kumar Singh of the Regional Meteorological Center informed- The spell of rain that has been continuing in UP since April 30 has taken a break. There will be intense heat for 2 days. Nights may also remain hot in some areas. However, there will be relief from heatwaves for now. A new western disturbance will become active from May 12. Conditions like rain, thunderstorms, and hail will develop. Condition of Major Cities Why the fluctuations in weather? The Meteorological Department says that the weather in the mountains of Uttarakhand is constantly changing. There is snowfall in some places and rain in others. Meanwhile, on some days, the weather clears up with sunshine. Such fluctuations are expected for the next few days. Its direct impact is visible in UP. The winds coming from the mountains are keeping the weather cold. They are creating systems favorable for rain. What will the weather be like for the next 5 days? Forecast of less rainfall in monsoon this year Private weather agency Skymet Weather has released the forecast for this year's monsoon. According to it, monsoon rainfall may be 6% less than normal. The normal average rainfall in the country during the 4 months of monsoon from June to September is 868.6 mm. Less than normal monsoon means rainfall will be between 90% to 95%. The agency has forecast 94% rainfall. There will be normal rainfall in June, but the decline will start from July, and the monsoon will weaken in August and September. Especially in August-September, there are indications of a more rainfall deficit. UP will also receive less rainfall during monsoon, know the reason Between June and September, Uttar Pradesh is also likely to receive below-normal rainfall. Director General of the Meteorological Department, Dr. M Mahapatra, said that this year there are signs of La Niña-like conditions ending in the Pacific Ocean and moving towards El Niño, which will cause less rainfall. This means there are indications that the south-west monsoon will be weaker than normal this year. Additionally, the reduced snow formation in the Northern Hemisphere during January-March this year may also affect the monsoon. Know about El Niño and La Niña
